Name: (AT) Dachshund - Cherry
Author: JackR0
Description:
Had my friend commission me to put her dogs into the game, and here is one of them! Her name is Cherry and she's an adorable little dachshund <3
I figured I would upload it here (with permission) in case anyone else wanted her in their game!

[b][color=#ff7700]---------------------------------------[/color][/b]

[b]How To Use:[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy Scissors from Robin
[*]Interact with any dog while holding the scissors, and voila! You have your very own adorable Cherry ﻿
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][b]---------------------------------------[/b][/color]

[b]Installation[/b]

[list]
[*][b]SMAPI - and requirements[/b]
[/list] ﻿ Make sure SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) and AT (Alternative Textures) are downloaded and up to date!
[b]
﻿2. Dachshund - Cherry[/b]
﻿ Install this mod! 

[b]﻿3. Mod Folder[/b]
﻿ Unzip Dachshund - Cherry and place it into your mods folder! (It can be in a subfolder if you like to keep things organized.)

[b][color=#ff7700]---------------------------------------[/color]

[/b][b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]If you encounter any bugs or issues, as always, let me know!
[*]This was something completely new for me, but it was [i]so[/i] much fun watching my friend's dog come to life in pixel form <3
[*]She is not compatible with hats because she's tiny compared to the vanilla dogs (If there is a way I can change this, let me know!)
[/list]
